title: Showroom Sales & Administration Assistant
experience: Previous experience in sales, preferably within interiors, furniture, furnishings or a related industry
description_text:
Our client, an established business specialising in beautiful interiors and home furnishings, is looking for an enthusiastic and experienced Showroom Sales & Administration Assistant to join their team. 
 This is an excellent opportunity for someone with a passion for interior design, an eye for aesthetics and a strong background in sales and administration.
 Main Responsibilities
 Welcome and assist customers visiting the showroom, providing excellent customer service.
 Advise clients on furniture, fabrics, wallpapers, lighting and home accessories.
 Assist customers with product selections, colour schemes and furnishing combinations.
 Handle B2C sales enquiries and guide customers throughout the purchasing process.
 Prepare quotations, invoices and other sales documentation.
 Process customer orders and coordinate deliveries.
 Follow up with suppliers and customers to ensure smooth order processing.
 Manage the day-to-day showroom administration and back-office activities.
 Maintain an attractive, organised and welcoming showroom environment.
 Requirements
 Previous experience in sales, preferably within interiors, furniture, furnishings or a related industry.
 A genuine passion for interior design and a natural flair for aesthetics.
 Strong administrative and organisational skills.
 Confidence in preparing quotations, invoices and managing orders.
 Good computer skills and attention to detail.
 Excellent communication and customer service skills.
 Ability to work independently, take initiative and manage responsibilities.
 A valid driving licence.
 Good physical ability to assist with handling products when required.
 Working Hours
 Monday to Friday
 Occasional Saturday work
 Salary & Benefits
 €1,500 – €1,800 net per month, depending on experience.
 Additional percentage-based commission on sales.
 Company laptop and mobile phone.
 28 days of annual leave.
 Expected Start Date: Ideally by the end of the year or January.
 If you have a passion for beautiful interiors, enjoy working with customers and have the sales and organisational skills we are looking for, we would love to hear from you!
 Apply now by submitting your CV to Outreach Recruitment Agency.
